title: Report a sign-in wall as a false alarm
description: Report that the sign-in or verification wall DSphere reads on a page (authentication.status sign-in-required) is a false alarm: the page needs no sign-in or check for the task, as the person's "False Alarm, Skip And Resume" on the sign-in sheet does.
guidance: Call it only when the page evidence shows it (dsagent.page.markdown or observe show the page's own content, and what DSphere took for a wall is, for example, a set of links to separate sign-in pages) or your user told you so; never to get past a sign-in or check the task needs: signing in stays the person's. The Extension reads the page again and records the wall it finds as none for this page only, until the tab moves to another address; another kind of wall, and every other page, are judged as before, and nothing is recorded as a sign-in. A task or run paused on the page then resumes as after any wall that went away (a run within a few seconds; follow it with dsagent.execution.wait), and your next read of the page carries authentication no-wall. outcome no-wall: no wall stood when the page was read. Refused, with nothing recorded, while the browser's own sign-in dialog holds the page (businessCode AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED) or when the page could not be read (SIGN_IN_UNVERIFIED: wait a moment and retry). Requires an idempotency key.

inputSchema.description: The page whose wall is a false alarm.

pageContextId.description: The page the wall stands on: a pageContextId from dsagent.page.open, dsagent.pages.list or a paused run (pause.pageContextId).
The page the wall stands on: a pageContextId from dsagent.page.open, dsagent.pages.list or a paused run (pause.pageContextId).

outcome.description: reported: the wall standing on the page is recorded as a false alarm for this page; no-wall: no wall stood when the page was read, nothing was recorded.

wallType.description: With reported: the kind of wall reported (LOGIN_FORM, CAPTCHA, ...).

cleared.description: Whether the page now reads clear. False only when another kind of wall still stands there; that wall is the person's as usual.
